name: Dürnstein castle ruin
why: Up a rocky path from a blue-towered abbey to the ruined castle where Richard the Lionheart was held prisoner, the Danube and the vineyards of the Wachau below.
book: Free. Train or boat to Dürnstein from Krems or Melk.

points.name: Dürnstein
points.note: A walled wine village with a blue and white abbey tower by the Danube.

points.name: Dürnstein Castle
points.note: The ruins on a rock above the village.
